description: NaBaGaF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.51 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.77 Å. There are two inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Ba-F bond distances ranging from 2.61-3.10 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Ba-F bond distances ranging from 2.62-3.12 Å. There are two inequivalent Ga sites. In the first Ga site, Ga is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Ga-F bond distances ranging from 1.88-1.92 Å. In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Ga-F bond distances ranging from 1.88-1.92 Å. There are twelve inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, and one Ga atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Ga atom. In the third F site, F is bonded to two Na, one Ba, and one Ga atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FBaNa₂Ga trigonal pyramids. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, and one Ga atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, and one Ga atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Ga atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded to two Na, one Ba, and one Ga atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FBaNa₂Ga tetrahedra. In the eighth F site, F is bonded to two Na, one Ba, and one Ga atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FBaNa₂Ga trigonal pyramids. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, and one Ga atom. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Ba and one Ga atom. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ba, and one Ga atom. In the twelfth F site, F is bonded to two Na, one Ba, and one Ga atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FBaNa₂Ga tetrahedra.
